source_text: {We have defined the simplicial finite element spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ in a systematic and unified fashion in any dimension $n$ for every $0\leq k\leq n$ and $r\geq1$. In one, two, and three dimensions these spaces of finite element differential forms may be identified via proxies with spaces of scalar- and vector-valued finite element spaces. In this way, they unify a broad range of finite element methods, developed relatively independently by many researchers over a period of many decades.}
translated_text: {对任意维数 $n$, 每个 $0\leq k\leq n$ 和 $r\geq1$, 已用系统而统一的方式定义了单纯形有限元空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$. 在一维, 二维和三维中, 这些有限元微分形式空间可通过代理与标量值和向量值有限元空间等同. 这样, 它们统一了许多研究者在数十年间相对独立地发展出的一大类有限元方法.}

source_text: {In any number of dimensions, the spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^0$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^0$ coincide with each other and identify with the most classical finite element space, the Lagrange space of continuous piecewise polynomials of degree at most $r$, going back in the case $r=1$ to Courant \BookCite{36} in 1943. These are the most natural finite elements to use to discretize the space $H^1$. The spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^n$ and $\mathcal P_{r+1}^-\Lambda^n$ (note the change of index) also coincide with each other, and they identify with the larger space of all piecewise polynomials of degree at most $r$, whether continuous or not, the natural finite element discretization of $L^2$. Such spaces are used in finite element calculations in the discontinuous Galerkin method, initiated by Reed and Hill \BookCite{65} in 1973. The spaces $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^1$ in two dimensions identify with the famous space of Raviart and Thomas \BookCite{64}, introduced in 1975, to discretize $H(\operatorname{div})$. That space was generalized in two different ways to three dimensions in 1980 by Nédélec \BookCite{59}, once as a discretization of $H(\operatorname{div})$, the other as a discretization of $H(\operatorname{curl})$. These correspond to the spaces $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^1$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^2$ in three dimensions, respectively. Finally, the two-dimensional space $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^1$ identifies with the Brezzi–Douglas–Marini space from 1985 and the three-dimensional spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^1$ and $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^2$ with their generalization by Nédélec in 1986, referred to as the Nédélec edge and face elements of the second kind. Thus, in $n\leq3$ dimensions, all these spaces have appeared in the finite element literature. The FEEC treatment revealed the unity among these spaces, which had arisen in diverse contexts. In some cases, the most natural DOFs for the spaces were not known before the development of FEEC.}
translated_text: {在任意维数中, 空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^0$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^0$ 彼此重合, 并与最经典的有限元空间等同, 即次数至多为 $r$ 的连续分片多项式构成的 Lagrange 空间; 当 $r=1$ 时, 它可追溯到 Courant 于 1943 年的工作 \BookCite{36}. 它们是离散化空间 $H^1$ 最自然的有限元. 空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^n$ 与 $\mathcal P_{r+1}^-\Lambda^n$ (注意指标的变化) 也彼此重合, 并与所有次数至多为 $r$ 的分片多项式组成的更大空间等同, 无论这些多项式是否连续; 这是 $L^2$ 的自然有限元离散化. Reed 和 Hill 于 1973 年开创的间断 Galerkin 方法 \BookCite{65} 在有限元计算中使用这样的空间. 二维中的空间 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^1$ 与 Raviart 和 Thomas 于 1975 年引入的著名空间 \BookCite{64} 等同, 用于离散化 $H(\operatorname{div})$. Nédélec 于 1980 年 \BookCite{59} 以两种不同方式将该空间推广至三维, 一种作为 $H(\operatorname{div})$ 的离散化, 另一种作为 $H(\operatorname{curl})$ 的离散化. 它们分别对应于三维中的空间 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^1$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^2$. 最后, 二维空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^1$ 与 1985 年的 Brezzi–Douglas–Marini 空间等同, 而三维空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^1$ 和 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^2$ 则与 Nédélec 于 1986 年给出的推广等同, 称为第二类 Nédélec 棱单元和面单元. 因此, 在 $n\leq3$ 维时, 所有这些空间都已出现于有限元文献中. FEEC 的处理揭示了这些在不同背景下产生的空间之间的统一性. 在某些情形中, 这些空间最自然的自由度在 FEEC 发展以前还不为人所知.}

source_text: {It is also worth noting that some of these spaces of piecewise polynomial differential forms appeared independently in the context of geometry. The spaces $\mathcal P_1^-\Lambda^k$ are highly geometric, having one DOF per $k$-simplex in the triangulation, and so being isomorphic to the space of simplicial $k$-cochains. Indeed, these spaces were constructed by Whitney in his 1957 book \BookCite{70}, decades before their appearance as mixed finite elements. The connection to mixed finite elements was pointed out much later yet, by Bossavit \BookCite{20} in 1988. Further, the complete polynomial spaces $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ associated to a triangulation make an appearance in the topological work of Sullivan \BookCite{67}, \BookCite{68} in the 1970s, a decade before their reinvention as Brezzi–Douglas–Marini elements. In a largely overlooked conference proceedings from the early 1980s \BookCite{17}, Baker called these Sullivan–Whitney forms and he analyzed the convergence of a discretization of an eigenvalue problem for the Hodge Laplacian using them. A first unified treatment of the $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ spaces was made in a seminal paper of Hiptmair \BookCite{50} in 1999. In the 2006 paper of Arnold, Falk, and Winther \BookCite{11} in which the term \emph{finite element exterior calculus} first appeared, the Koszul complex was first applied to finite elements, allowing a major simplification and a unified treatment of both the $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ and $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ spaces.}
translated_text: {还值得注意的是, 这些分片多项式微分形式空间中, 有些独立地出现于几何背景下. 空间 $\mathcal P_1^-\Lambda^k$ 具有很强的几何性, 剖分中每个 $k$-单纯形对应一个自由度, 因而与单纯 $k$-上链空间同构. 事实上, Whitney 在 1957 年的著作 \BookCite{70} 中就构造了这些空间, 比它们作为混合有限元出现早数十年. 它们与混合有限元的联系则迟至 1988 年才由 Bossavit \BookCite{20} 指出. 此外, 与剖分关联的完全多项式空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ 出现在 Sullivan 于 1970 年代的拓扑学工作 \BookCite{67}, \BookCite{68} 中, 比它们作为 Brezzi–Douglas–Marini 单元被重新发现早十年. 在 1980 年代初的一本大体上被忽视的会议论文集 \BookCite{17} 中, Baker 将其称为 Sullivan–Whitney 形式, 并用它们离散化 Hodge Laplacian 的一个特征值问题, 分析了该离散化的收敛性. Hiptmair 于 1999 年的一篇奠基性论文 \BookCite{50} 首次统一处理了 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ 空间. 在 Arnold, Falk 和 Winther 于 2006 年发表的论文 \BookCite{11} 中, \emph{有限元外微积分}这一术语首次出现, Koszul 复形首次应用于有限元, 从而使 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ 和 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ 两类空间得以大幅简化并得到统一处理.}

source_text: {For the cubic finite element spaces, we briefly described the two families $\mathcal Q_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ and $\mathcal S_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$. The former can be considered a tensor product analogue of the $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ spaces and had been derived alongside the corresponding simplicial spaces. For example, in two dimensions the $\mathcal Q_r^-\Lambda^1$ spaces are the quadrilateral Raviart–Thomas spaces from \BookCite{64}. The $\mathcal S_r\Lambda^k$ family is different in that it was largely absent from the literature and its discovery was inspired by FEEC. The elements for 0-forms, ordinary $H^1$ finite elements, are well-known in two dimensions. They are the popular serendipity finite elements. The construction of $\mathcal S_r\Lambda^0$ gives the systematic generalization of these elements to higher dimensions. The $\mathcal S_r$ spaces for 1-forms and 2-forms in three and more dimensions were likewise not previously known.}
translated_text: {对于立方体有限元空间, 我们简要介绍了 $\mathcal Q_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 和 $\mathcal S_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 两族. 前者可视为 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 空间的张量积对应物, 它们曾与相应的单纯形空间一同被导出. 例如, 二维中的 $\mathcal Q_r^-\Lambda^1$ 空间就是 \BookCite{64} 中的四边形 Raviart–Thomas 空间. $\mathcal S_r\Lambda^k$ 族则不同, 它在既有文献中基本未曾出现, 其发现受到 FEEC 的启发. 对 0-形式的单元, 即通常的 $H^1$ 有限元, 在二维中已广为人知, 就是常用的 Serendipity 有限元. $\mathcal S_r\Lambda^0$ 的构造将这些单元系统地推广到了更高维. 三维及更高维中用于 1-形式和 2-形式的 $\mathcal S_r$ 空间, 此前同样不为人所知.}

source_text: {Give an $n$-dimension simplicial triangulation $\mathcal T_h$ for any $n\geq1$, any form degree $0\leq k\leq n$, and any polynomial degree $r\geq1$, there are two canonical spaces of finite element differential $k$-forms consisting of piecewise polynomials of degree $r$ or less, the complete polynomial space $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ and the trimmed polynomial space $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$. Like any finite element spaces, these can be specified by giving their shape functions and DOFs and showing that these are unisolvent.}
translated_text: {给定任意 $n\geq1$ 的 $n$ 维单纯形剖分 $\mathcal T_h$, 对任意形式次数 $0\leq k\leq n$ 和任意多项式次数 $r\geq1$, 都有两个典范的有限元微分 $k$-形式空间, 由次数不超过 $r$ 的分片多项式组成, 即完全多项式空间 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$ 和修剪多项式空间 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k(\mathcal T_h)$. 与任何有限元空间一样, 可以通过给出形函数和自由度并证明其唯一可解性来指定这些空间.}

source_text: {As the name suggests, the shape functions for the complete polynomial space consist of all $k$-forms with coefficients which are polynomials of degree at most $r$. The trimmed polynomial space restricts the coefficient polynomials to a subspace of all polynomials of degree at most $r$ but which contains at least all polynomials of degree at most $r-1$. It is precisely defined in terms of the Koszul complex. In the case of 0-forms, the trimmed space coincides with the complete polynomial space of the same degree, while for the case of $n$-forms, it coincides with the complete polynomial space of degree $r-1$. In all other cases, the trimmed space is not a complete polynomial space. In the lowest order case $r=1$, the trimmed spaces are the spaces of Whitney forms.}
translated_text: {顾名思义, 完全多项式空间的形函数由系数为次数至多 $r$ 的多项式的所有 $k$-形式组成. 修剪多项式空间将系数多项式限制在所有次数至多 $r$ 的多项式的某个子空间中, 但该子空间至少包含所有次数至多 $r-1$ 的多项式. 它借助 Koszul 复形精确定义. 对 0-形式, 修剪空间与相同次数的完全多项式空间重合; 对 $n$-形式, 则与次数为 $r-1$ 的完全多项式空间重合. 在所有其他情形中, 修剪空间不是完全多项式空间. 在最低阶情形 $r=1$ 时, 修剪空间就是 Whitney 形式空间.}

source_text: {The complete polynomial spaces with $r$ decreasing as $k$ increases combine to form a subcomplex of the $L^2$ de Rham complex with bounded cochain projections. The trimmed polynomial spaces similarly form a de Rham subcomplex, but with degree $r$ constant.}
translated_text: {完全多项式空间在 $k$ 增加时让 $r$ 递减, 组合成具有有界上链投影的 $L^2$ de Rham 复形的子复形. 修剪多项式空间也类似地构成 de Rham 子复形, 但次数 $r$ 保持不变.}

source_text: {Two such spaces, one for $k$-forms and one for $(k-1)$-forms, either both complete, both trimmed, or one of each, can be used to solve the $k$-form Hodge Laplacian, as indicated in \eqref{eq:four-galerkin-form-pairs}.}
translated_text: {如 \eqref{eq:four-galerkin-form-pairs} 所示, 两个这样的空间, 一个用于 $k$-形式, 一个用于 $(k-1)$-形式, 无论两者均为完全空间, 均为修剪空间, 还是各取其一, 都可用于求解 $k$-形式 Hodge Laplacian.}
